WITH per_transaction AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    avg_anlycount,
    avg_anlycount - AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS above_overall,
    AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS overall_average
  FROM per_transaction
),
kept AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    avg_anlycount,
    above_overall,
    avg_anlycount - AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS above_kept_average
  FROM scored
  WHERE avg_anlycount > overall_average
)
SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall, above_kept_average
FROM kept
ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC NULLS LAST
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS WITH TIES;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the unweighted average of the per-transaction averages; transactions with no non-missing anlycount have a NULL average and are excluded by the above-average filter.
